evidence_spans.text:
We analyzed the preprocessed data available on the ABIDE 
preprocessed homepage (29, 30), using the Configurable Pipeline 
for the Analysis of Connectomes (CPAC) (31), that includes slice-
timing, motion correction, intensity normalization, nuisance 
signal removal (e.g. tissue signals, low-frequency drifts), and 
registrations.
evidence_spans.claim: Preprocessing used the Preprocessed Connectomes Project CPAC pipeline.

evidence_spans.text:
Both anatomical and functional atlases were chosen to derive the 
FC measures; in particular, we chose Harvard-Oxford (HO) and 
Automatic Anatomical Labeling (AAL) as anatomical templates 
and Craddock-200 (CC) as functional templates to extract time 
series from brain regions
evidence_spans.claim: Four atlases (AAL, HO, CC, Power) were compared for the connectivity analysis.

each training set was composed by all the sites except one, that

evidence_spans.text:
The mean L-SVM classification performance, 
in terms of the area under the ROC curve (AUC), was 0.75 ± 0.05. The highest performance 
was obtained using data from KKI, NYU and UCLA sites in training and data from UM as testing 
set (AUC = 0.83).
evidence_spans.claim: Leave-one-site-out SVM classification reached mean AUC 0.75 ± 0.05, best fold AUC 0.83.

evidence_spans.text:
Specifically, stronger functional connectivity (FC) in ASD with respect to TD 
involve (p < 0.001) the angular gyrus with the precuneus in the right (R) hemisphere, and the 
R frontal operculum cortex with the pars opercularis of the left (L) inferior frontal gyrus.
evidence_spans.claim: ASD showed hyper-connectivity between right angular gyrus-precuneus (DMN) and right frontal operculum-left IFG pars opercularis.

charting.key_performance_results: DMN-derived biomarker A4 AUC = 0.745 (significantly higher than the RSN-template-only biomarker R4, AUC = 0.590, p<0.05) for distinguishing ASD in the local cohort
charting.features_associated_disorder: Default mode network (DMN) and executive control network (ECN) biomarkers differed significantly between ASD and TD
charting.feature_change_direction: DMN functional connectivity was weaker (hypoconnectivity) in ASD than TD; A4 (DMN) biomarker negatively correlated with SRS severity scores
charting.dataset_openly_available: The 30 biomarker masks and pipeline are shared on GitHub (https://github.com/htygithub/ASDmask/); the underlying datasets (including the local cohort) are available only from the corresponding author on reasonable request

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Both (biomarker group-difference derivation + ROC/AUC validation); ABIDE I+II (2095 subjects, 1001 ASD/1094 TD, 33 sites) for derivation, local KMUH cohort (21 ASD, 23 TD) for validation.
narrative_row.methods: FSL-based lab-made pipeline; dual-regression functional connectivity against the Smith09 RSN10 template; FWE-corrected two-sample t-tests to derive 30 biomarker masks (R1-R10, A1-A20); ROC/AUC and FDR-corrected correlation analyses in the local cohort against SRS/SNAP-IV scores.
narrative_row.outcomes: DMN and executive-control-network biomarkers differed significantly between ASD and TD; DMN connectivity was weaker in ASD; DMN-derived biomarker A4 reached AUC 0.745 in the local cohort, significantly outperforming its RSN-template-only counterpart (AUC 0.590); DMN biomarkers correlated negatively with SRS severity.
narrative_row.key_limitations: No age/sex/site covariate handling when pooling ABIDE I and II across 33 sites for the derivation step; no motion-exclusion threshold reported; underlying datasets available only on reasonable request (biomarker masks/pipeline are public).
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A clear example of deriving a biomarker from the full ABIDE I+II release and testing its transfer to an independent, non-ABIDE clinical cohort, including an explicit ROC/AUC diagnostic-utility evaluation.

kg_link.cohort_description: Full ABIDE I (1112, 17 sites) and ABIDE II (983, 16 sites) releases used for biomarker derivation: 2095 subjects total, 1001 ASD and 1094 TD, ages 5-64.
kg_link.pipeline: Lab-made FSL-based pipeline (FSL-BET, FSL-BBreg, FSL-FNIRT, CompCor, dual regression), methodologically similar to C-PAC
kg_link.atlas: Smith et al. 2009 RSN10 ICA network template (no discrete ROI atlas)
kg_link.finding: DMN and executive-control-network biomarkers differed significantly between ASD and TD in ABIDE (weaker DMN connectivity in ASD); the DMN-derived biomarker A4 achieved AUC 0.745 for distinguishing ASD in an independent local validation cohort, significantly higher than its RSN-template-only counterpart (AUC 0.590).

This study included 1112 ABIDE I datasets 
from 17 sites and 983 ABIDE II datasets from 16 sites. The ABIDE datasets were obtained online15. In total, 2095 
ABIDE datasets were used (ASD: 1001 and TD: 1094; 5–64 years).

The areas 
under the curve (AUCs) for the biomarkers were (0.590, 0.745, p < 0.05), (0.588, 0.646), and (0.646, 0.677) for 
(R4, A4), (R5, A15), and (R8, A18), respectively.
